answer_1.quote: Recently, large language models have shown impressive performance in text and code generation, reasoning, and decision-making tasks, which paves the way for building an agent to automate computer tasks.
answer_1.outputs: The generated outputs include code-like actions (e.g., click, fill, navigate) and natural language reasoning traces for web navigation tasks in interactive environments.

answer_2.quote: On WEBARENA and VISUALWEBARENA, while orthogonal to the other methods, CER achieves competitive performance and improves the baseline agent, GPT-4o w/ BrowserGym (Drouin et al., 2024), relatively by 51.0% (CER hybrid) and 21.8% (CER online) respectively.
